object: One-selection local media continuity plus Journey Ride 0.1
problem: SET knew exact source hashes but LISTEN and future JOURNEY still required repeated file-picker binding because source references did not resolve to persistent local browser blobs.
implemented: same-origin IndexedDB local media vault keyed by exact SHA-256 source ID
SET capture stores selected blobs locally while Experience Set remains byte-free
SET source cells expose LISTEN / LISTEN-BIND according to vault availability
LISTEN accepts ?source=sha256:... and resolves the local blob without another picker interaction
LISTEN exposes an exact RETURN link to the calling surface
Journey Ride consumes the existing Experience Set plus exact local bindings
Journey derives a continuous address beside immutable source clocks
CUT, CARRY, DISSOLVE and RESET have bounded traversal semantics
stop: Do not add cloud storage, provider synchronization, beatmatching, tempo warping, concatenated media export or new Experience Set ontology in this pass.
